147: After arriving in India, Indiana Jones is asked by a desperate village to find a mystical stone. He agrees – and stumbles upon a secret cult plotting a terrible plan in the catacombs of an ancient palace.
If adventure has a name... it must be Indiana Jones.
403: It has been twenty years since Don Diego de la Vega fought Spanish oppression in Alta California as the legendary romantic hero, Zorro. No one has seen his face... but everyone... knows this mark.
Don Diego de la Vega / Zorro
659: New Jersey teen Daniel LaRusso moves to Los Angeles with his mother, and soon strikes up a relationship with Ali. He quickly finds himself the target of bullying by a group of thugs, led by Ali's ex-boyfriend Johnny, who study karate at the Cobra Kai dojo under ruthless sensei John Kreese. He taught him the secret to karate lies in the mind and heart. Not in the hands.

1171: Rey develops her newly discovered abilities with the guidance of Luke Skywalker, who is unsettled by the strength of her powers. Meanwhile, the Resistance prepares to do battle with the First Order.

Brace yourself. This politician is about to tell the truth!

Bennett Holiday is an American lawyer in charge of facilitating a dubious merger of oil companies, while Bryan Woodman, a Switzerland-based energy analyst, experiences both personal tragedy and opportunity during a visit with Arabian royalty. Meanwhile, veteran CIA agent Bob Barnes uncovers an assassination plot with unsettling origins.
1939: Deckard Shaw seeks revenge against Dominic Toretto and his family for his comatose brother.
2195: Emma is a busy doctor who sets up a seemingly perfect arrangement when she offers her best friend Adam a relationship with one rule: No strings attached. But when a fling becomes a thing, can sex friends stay best friends?
2451: A British estate agent travels to Transylvania to meet with the mysterious Count Dracula, who is interested in leasing a London castle. The story of the strangest passion the world has ever known!

No fear. No limits. No equal.
2963: Bill McKay is a candidate for the U.S. Senate from California. He has no hope of winning, so he is willing to tweak the establishment.
Bill McKay has a lot going for him...but nothing compared to what's coming.
3219: Several players from different backgrounds try to cope with the pressures of playing football at a major university. Each deals with the pressure differently, some turn to drinking, others to drugs, and some to studying.
Pressure surrounds them. Competition divides them. Glory unites them.
3475: The greatest Olympic Wrestling Champion brother team joins Team Foxcatcher led by multimillionaire sponsor John E. du Pont as they train for the 1988 games in Seoul - a union that leads to unlikely circumstances.

The world's leaders have assembled. So have their enemies.

The search for her son was over. The search for her family was just beginning.
4499: A rich brat fakes her own kidnapping, but in the process ends up locked in the trunk of a car that gets stolen.
A crash course in kidnappings, car thefts and other rituals of dating.

Right and Wrong no longer exist

The Search for the Perfect Wave!

How do you say goodbye to someone you can't imagine living without?

He's not here to save the world.

Everything interesting begins in the mind
6035: The unassuming, nebbishy inventor Sidney Stratton creates a miraculous fabric that will never be dirty or worn out. Guinness is Back...Working Wonders With Wile, Whimsey and Wit!
6291: For many years, Nathan Harper has had the uneasy feeling that life with his family isn't quite what it seems. As he draws closer to uncovering the truth, he is hunted by assassins, forcing him to flee with his neighbor, Karen, the only person he can trust.
The fight for the truth will be the fight of his life.

The perfect love story. Until it became the perfect crime.

7571: A depressed housewife whose husband is having an affair contemplates suicide, but changes her mind when she faces death by a killer hired to do her in.
A comedy about a wife, her husband and his hit man.

A romantic comedy about the things we do for love.
8339: Paul Aufiero, a 35-year-old parking-garage attendant from Staten Island, is the self-described "world's biggest New York Giants fan". The Pick-Up Artist... has finally met his match.

BACK AGAIN - INGRID BERGMAN in her greatest role

It's time to kick some legendary tale.

Ever have one of those nights?

Surrounded by danger, they'll risk everything for freedom!

Two cats... one car... and a world of hurt...

Did a Woman Start the Rout of Rommel?
Cpl. John J. Bramble / Paul Davos

It will take you to the edge of suspense.

One of the living for one of the dead.
13715: A suspense thriller about a reporter from Miami who travels to Ecuador in pursuit of a serial killer known as the "Monster of Babahoyo."
If It's On TV, It Must Be The Truth.
13971: A team of US Special Ops forces is dispatched to a remote mountain region of Afghanistan with orders to locate an influential Muslim cleric. 14227: When stubborn, spotty Kevin and his equally hopeless best friend Perry go on holiday to the party island Ibiza, they see it as their big chance to become superstar club DJs and, more importantly, to lose their virginities. All they want to do is... Do it!!!

Sound you can see in the movie you can feel!

She's a Type A without a Plan B.

If you thought divorce was ugly, try marriage!

The hard-working valet Antonio accidentally appears in the same photo and is enlisted to pose as Olivia’s new boyfriend as a cover-up. This ruse with Olivia thrusts Antonio into the spotlight and unexpected chaos.
Never judge a couple by their cover.

The sheriff chases the brothers to Mexico. They join forces, however, against a group of Mexican bandits.
There are "Westerns" and "Westerns". Every now and then comes a NEW kind of Western. This is "BANDOLERO!".
17299: Seven short films - each one focused on the plight of a different child protagonist.
17811: Simrita, a doctor, performs her first surgery on Viraj, a man she hates. She soon realises that she accidentally left her watch inside his body and must do whatever it takes to save her career.
Super Stuntman .... Supermodel .... Feel the Love - The Battle Begins this Summer!

Lubos and Eman make attempts to sell the baby to Miluska and Frantisek, a barren couple.
A comedy that makes you cry. A drama that makes you laugh.

Now tell me the truth, who’s coming here tonight? DEATH!

Every day I wake up at a different age in a different year on a different day of my life. I want it to stop.

No tights. No cape. No problem.

For his last love, fate led him to betray his first love.

Stay Home. Lock Up. Don't Breathe.

Can Gilberte play one off against another? And who will manage to kiss whom on the lips?

Forget all the suspense you have ever seen! Forget all the excitement you have ever known!
Col. Otis Fosgate - president of the court-martial

Dodo wants her back very badly and has erotic daydreams about her. A beautiful young student in his class asks him for a ride home and seduces the lucky man, but still he wonders about his wife and her lover.

Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.
Went the day well? We died and never knew. But, well or ill, freedom we died for you.

A good football coach, can get away with murder
22163: Leveraging his ability to withstand pain, a young man trains to follow in the footsteps of his martial arts hero.
22675: Young women at a precision optics factory in wartime Japan push to exceed production quotas, enduring illness, injury, and personal hardship to “serve the country.” Led by Tsuru Watanabe, they fight fatigue and setbacks to keep their line moving—even when duty collides with grief.
Soichi Yoshikawa, Chief of General Affairs Section
Ken Shinda, Chief of Labor Section
Tsuru Watanabe, president of women workers
Yuriko Tanimura, vice president of women workers

Hamza Ali Mazari / Jaskirat Singh Rangi

23955: Garfield, the world-famous, Monday-hating, lasagna-loving indoor cat, is about to have a wild outdoor adventure! They messed with the wrong senior citizen.

All a father needs is a fighting chance.

Mohamed Benmahmoud, le père de Bahia
Cécile Benhmamoud, la mère de Bahia

Thrill jumping guys... Thrill seeking girls... Daring death with every leap!

The Artist Who Opposed The Soviet Dictatorship.
29843: Viren falls for Pallavi, but she marries Siddharth. The couple dies, leaving behind their daughter, who grows up to look just like her mother and falls in love with Viren.
30099: A young boy and his sister are drawn into one man's obsessive pursuit of his former lover.

30611: Set in the glamour of the New York and Paris art scenes, gallery owner Brooke Gatwick and her newscaster husband Owen Shore, face temptation, jealousy, twists and mystery when two seductive newcomers enter their lives.

31123: A wicked investor wants Werner's residential area razed to the ground in order to build a shopping center. However, building tycoon Günzelsen has not reckoned with Werner. Together with his master Röhrich he's planning to blow away the plumbings with a gigantic obstruction...
31379: After the gangsters who killed his father come to settle a score, a teenage boy and his mother turn the tables on the killers - one Latino family's quest for honor and revenge as the hunted become the hunters.
31635: A woman flees two serial killers who are hot on her heels in a forest.

One man's journey to find healing.

Mahogany – the woman every woman wants to be – and every man wants to have
33171: After the death of his father, a teenage boy forms a healing friendship with a park ranger in the Yorkshire Dales.
From the heart of a boy comes the story of a man.

When there's no water, you have to play dirty.

Run JULIE Run, Run For Your Life!

34195: Jong-dae and Yong-ki make a living by picking up paper and empty bottles. Both then join different gangster clan and becomes involved in a struggle of political interests over development in Gangnam, Seoul.
Seoul 1970 the era of ambition and avarice.

34707: Nine year old Mihir and his friends are faced with the daunting task of outwitting the biggest, meanest bully in school, Rahul Malhotra. 35731: Investigates the corrupt judicial system under which Alain Mar'caux and his wife Edith were arrested on accusations of pedophilia horrific acts they never committed- and the years he spent fighting to get out of prison, clear his name and keep his family.
For justice, there were no innocents.

Every man has his own mountain to climb
36243: Arun, a newly recruited sub-inspector, sets out in pursuit of a mysterious serial killer who targets young girls and murders them. 36499: The Black Mask must stop a group intent on setting off a DNA bomb that could cause mutations to the human race.
36755: Out on a dead calm ocean, in a thick fog, a group of tourists on a pleasure craft are about to cross paths with an ancient and terrible evil. Sharing the same ocean, a sick, dying old Greek man drifts alone on a stricken yacht.
37267: When a scientist and a pilot volunteer for a high profile space mission they are told their goal will be to do what no one has ever done before to find the end of the universe. After 13 years in space the ship crashes through the end of the known universe and into the unknown...
Their mission was to reach the edge of the universe... what they found was beyond imagination.
37523: Raped. Disemboweled. Nearly decapitated. Dumped on the outskirts of a nature reserve, dead - or so they thought. She needed a hero that night, so that's what she became. This is Alison's tale. A tale of monsters, miracles and hope.

It's time for you to know

38547: In 1960, four American scientists travel to a planet that has just entered Earth's solar system to see if it's able to support an Earth colony. They find an oxygen atmosphere, a lush earth-like forest, and earth-like animals living around a potable fresh-water lake.
SEE...A prehistoric world of fantastic adventure come to life!
38803: Ida lives hard and fast with too much drinking and a string of boyfriends, Sandor has very few friends and his mother insists that he practices ballet. Party girl meets a male ballet dancer on the Internet.
39059: A portrait of the lives of a disparate group of patrons and employees at an American watering hole today.
39571: The true story of two murders that shaped the lives of several college students who went on to become some of the most influential writers of the "Beat Generation."
Sex and Drugs before Rock and Roll
39827: A facially disfigured and mentally unhinged man wreaks his revenge on those he blames for his condition.
No woman was safe from his crushing arms...
40083: A wealthy businessman and a businesswoman face financial ruin during an economic crisis. As they try to recover, a comedic romance develops between them.
40339: An unhappily married couple moves to Vienna, where the wife’s married best friend lives, and soon, sparks fly between the wife and the best friend’s husband.
The oft told story.  His Best Friend and His Wife and ---
40595: SI Rajeev is assigned to interrogate Roopa regarding her husband Ajay's accidental death. Discovering that Roopa is also an SI, Rajeev investigates further and uncovers unexpected revelations in the case.
40851: An oil baron and a farmer standoff after the water on his farm is poisoned by her company.
41107: Far away, in the desolate Serbian wilderness, a U.S.-led fracking crew uncover a dormant monster gestating inside a centuries-old French soldier. Now awakened and exposed in its most dangerously fragile state, it tears through the men on the grounds in search of a new womb.
A hole new kind of hell.
41363: Atilla the Hun, Tarkan its power in order to bring the sword to the floor at the pursuit of the enemy's appointed.
41619: When a youth football team of 12 boys, aged 11-16, and their 25-year-old coach is trapped deep inside a cave in Northern Thailand, thousands of volunteers and soldiers from around the world unite in a race against time to find them.
Based on the incredible true story that captivated the world.
42131: The film revolves around the life of Tarak, a foley artist of Bengali film. Tarak's job is to create ambient sounds for films, but, he gradually gets trapped in his own world, a world full of sound.
42387: A schoolteacher's reputation is at risk when a video of her speaking up against injustice goes viral on the internet and is misinterpreted.
42643: A novelist struggling with writer's block enlists the aid of an assassin for some inspiration -- fully unaware that he is being set up to take the blame for a murder.
42899: An archeologist noticed that the texture of the relics discovered during the excavation of a glacier closely resembled a jade pendant seen in one of his dreams. He and his team then embark on an expedition into the depths of the glacier.

The End Of The Vengeance Trail

Life in Color marks Katharine Emmer’s directorial debut. She also wrote, produced, edited and stars in the film.
43667: A hitchhiker gets a ride with an oddball woman who has her husband's body in the trunk of the car.
A Dangerous Love Affair. A Lethal Deception.
43923: A story about a homeless teenager Chuma and her relationships with police.
44179: Hildegard von Bingen was truly a woman ahead of her time. A visionary in every sense of the word, this famed 12th-century Benedictine nun was a Christian mystic, composer, philosopher, playwright, poet, naturalist, scientist, physician, herbalist and ecological activist.
44691: Using never-before-seen archival footage, personal photos, first-person narratives, and cutting-edge, mouth-watering food cinematography, the film traces Julia Child's surprising path, from her struggles to create and publish the revolutionary Mastering the Art of French Cooking (1961) which has sold more than 2.5 million copies to date, to her empowering story of a woman who found fame in her 50s, and her calling as an unlikely television sensation.
The delicious life of America's first food icon.

Hannibal and His Fantastic Elephant Army That Clobbered Half the World!

She's hot, but she'll have to stay cool to stay alive.

This is the laughter-filled super comedy for all housewives nationwide!

Death is not what you think.

After being met with icy acceptance from her mother-in-law, then getting stranded with her in a blizzard, Francesca begins to discover terrifying secrets about her husband's family.
Run Francesca! Run for your life!

The Man With The Rope Scar ON HIS NECK!
50579: A mysterious stranger befriends a middle class family.
51091: Disappearing into a monkey costume and creating a new persona, Jane strives to break free from a toxic relationship when she encounters a suicidal radio show host, Roy, who presents a path to freedom. Hot on their heels is Jane's controlling partner, Wade, who aims to put an end to Jane's newfound freedom.
51603: An outwardly happy Australian couple journey to Calcutta to collect their adopted baby, but on arrival find that the arrangements have yet to be finalized. Soon, the intoxicating mystic power of the Indian city pulls them in separate and unexpected directions, and the vulnerability of their marriage begins to reveal itself.

She was chosen... as the Devil's bride.
